title: 杰克逊霍尔前瞻：美联储独立性成焦点，通胀粘性引关注
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This is supposed to be one of those sort of wonky speeches, it's not supposed to break any news, it's supposed to focus on his task forces and all these other sort of mechanisms
segments.zh: 这本来应该是一场学术性的演讲，不打算发布任何新闻，重点在于他的工作组以及其他幕后机制。

segments.en: about what's going on behind the scenes. But I mean, as you I'm sure you know, the market wants to hear something a little bit more direct.
segments.zh: 但正如您所知，市场希望听到更直接的信息。

segments.en: Do you think we're going to get it? I think we've got to get it.
segments.zh: 您认为我们会得到这样的信息吗？我认为我们必须得到。

segments.en: We have heard reporting that Kevin Warsha said that he'd like to reset after the July press conference, which didn't go as well as I think as he would have liked.
segments.zh: 有报道称，凯文·沃什希望在7月新闻发布会后重新调整，那次发布会效果可能不如他所愿。

segments.en: And I think what we need to hear from Kevin Warsha is one fed independence to they are committed to bringing inflation down and three, we do need to know something about their
segments.zh: 我认为我们需要从凯文·沃什那里听到三点：一是美联储的独立性，二是他们致力于降低通胀，三是我们需要了解他们的决策规则。

segments.en: decision rule. He doesn't have to do forward guidance, but he has to give us some sense of if that, if this happens, then what will the fed do?
segments.zh: 他不必给出前瞻性指引，但必须让我们感受到，如果发生这种情况，美联储会怎么做。

segments.en: And we're starting to hear that already from many within the fed that the PCE and X, for instance, even Williams, who is more dovish, has said if we continue to see the
segments.zh: 我们已经开始听到美联储内部许多人的声音，例如，即使是更鸽派的威廉姆斯也表示，如果我们继续看到核心PCE月度涨幅超过0.2%，那将是不可持续的。

segments.en: core PCE go up at a more than two tenths of a percent in a month, that is not something that's sustainable.
segments.zh: 那将是过于顽固的通胀，我认为这正是我们下周将在PCE数据中看到的。

segments.en: That's too sticky of inflation, and I think that's exactly what we are going to see next week with the PCE.
segments.zh: 而且这还没有考虑到我们看到的能源价格反弹的全部影响。

segments.en: And that's before we see the full effects of the rebound in energy prices that we've seen.
segments.zh: 而且这还没算上能源价格反弹带来的全部影响。

segments.en: Diesel costs are really picking up quite dramatically.
segments.zh: 柴油成本确实在急剧上升。

segments.en: And we also have some refineries that are now full out at capacity and some imports from Canada that are slowing down because of scheduled maintenance.
segments.zh: 而且一些炼油厂已满负荷运转，来自加拿大的部分进口因计划维护而放缓。
